sheet_log.scale: 1" = 59'-0" (Overall West Elevation); 1" = 49'-0" (Overall South Elevation); 1" = 29'-0" (Overall East Elevation); 1" = 49'-0" (Overall North Elevation)
sheet_log.notes: Sheet A-201 shows four overall exterior elevations (North, South, East, West) for an industrial building for Crow Holdings in Bartow County, Georgia. Scales vary per elevation. Finish codes 101-104 and 005 are called out on all elevations referencing painted concrete acrylic texture and pre-finished metal. TI panel heights at entry (44'-2") and standard (42'-2") are consistent across all elevations. Truck court is at -4'-0" relative to finish floor. RO (Rough Opening) dock door locations are noted. Grid lines are shown on each elevation but are not labeled with dimensions in legible detail at this resolution. Actual bay counts and individual opening quantities could not be precisely counted at this image resolution - field verification recommended. Glass schedule and exterior finish schedule are specification reference documents for material selection.

sheet_log.title: MISC. DETAILS
sheet_log.notes: Sheet A-401 is a miscellaneous details sheet for Crow Holdings Industrial - Cass White Road, Bartow County, Georgia. It contains 13 numbered architectural details at various scales ranging from 1/2"=1'-0" to 1-1/2"=1'-0". Details cover: bollard/guardrail construction, ramp and stair construction, dock leveler (future) sections/plans, pump/electrical room section, and fire riser/electrical panel protection. Quantities for linear guardrail runs, bollard counts, stair counts, and dock door counts are not enumerated on this sheet - they must be taken from floor plan sheets.
